description: This PHP class defines a data model for a Claim Request in the OrangeHRM system. It uses OpenAPI annotations to describe the schema for API documentation and implements methods to serialize the ClaimRequest entity into a structured response.

classes.name: ClaimRequestModel
classes.description: A model class used to transform a ClaimRequest entity into a serializable API response, including nested claim event and currency details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ClaimRequest entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
